adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action immediately opens a `bootbox.confirm` and on confirmation calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord()` without checking any in-flight state (e.g., `host.isDeleting` / `host.isSaving`) or disabling the delete button. In the template (`templates/components/embeddable-host.hbs`), the trash button is not disabled at all (`{{d-button icon="trash-o" action="delete" ...}}`). This makes it possible to trigger multiple confirmations/clicks and enqueue multiple `destroyRecord()` calls before the first resolves, leading to duplicate DELETE requests and potentially inconsistent UI/error responses.
